get_directions.description: Find the road route from a start to a finish, through any stops in between, in the order given. Returns the distance (km and miles) and travel time, each leg between stops, and, if you want them, turn-by-turn directions and the route line for a map. Have an address instead? Look it up first with OpenStreetMap Nominatim's 'Search for places' step and use its latitude and longitude.
get_directions.display_str_template: Get directions through the listed stops.

3. Continue onto Unter den Linden (1.3 km)
4. Continue onto Schloßplatz (B 2; B 5) (295 m)
5. Continue onto Karl-Liebknecht-Straße (B 2; B 5) (852 m)
6. Turn right onto Alexanderstraße (B 2; B 5) (152 m)
7. Turn right (25 m)
8. Arrive at Alexanderplatz

get_travel_times.description: Measure the travel time and road distance from each place in From to each place in To, and name the quickest pair. Use it to find which store, depot or technician is closest to a customer. Leave To empty to compare the From places with each other. Have an address instead? Look it up first with OpenStreetMap Nominatim's 'Search for places' step and use its latitude and longitude.
